The core work of environmental compliance inspectors is to study environmental regulations and license conditions to determine the inspection basis, conduct on-site inspections and sampling of pollution sources and facilities, secure evidence and create traceable records, determine violations based on facts and regulations and propose handling opinions, and finally produce inspection reports and enforcement documents.

title.text: Environmental Compliance Inspectors: duties, wages, and entry paths

subject.name: Environmental Compliance Inspectors
subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 13-1041.01, conduct on-site inspections and investigations of pollution sources and facilities, take samples and gather evidence according to protocol, determine compliance based on environmental regulations, and produce inspection reports and enforcement documents. (The U.S. wage and employment figures checked are broader-group figures.)
